title: Freeze the integration baseline and complete debt register

inventory

Regenerate complete divergence and import inventories; reconcile every initial row and newly discovered debt with one owner, including all currently allowlisted imports, tests, fixtures, documentation and generated metadata.
legal-budget

Record remaining full-PR line capacity and required ledger evidence per audited identity; identify source already merged upstream, real fork additions and unresolved over-cap routes before source edits.
notes: Initial evidence is 440 violations (291 fork-created files, 149 audited identities), 21 current edges (16 unallowlisted, five allowlisted), and 447 distinct source identities in the union. These are planning anchors, not a promise that main is unchanged. Starting a new worktree does not reset PR49 deltas: PrefetchLink already uses 19 PR lines if its changes remain in the combined merge range. Read AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md and ADR-0019 again at execution start.
verify: Complete canonical reports on pinned refs; exact inventory set equality, no unassigned rows, unchanged audited base/scope, and explicit source reconciliation. No implementation or budget writer in this milestone.

title: Specify simple native usage and measurable update outcomes
scope: Usage/update contract and baseline measurements; private fixture definitions, no live consumer writes.

Record the current create, install, add-vertical, add-shell, API, check, build, Node/workerd, framework-update and rollback journeys using existing public commands and representative fresh and customized consumers.
acceptance

Freeze testable outcomes: one documented supported update entry, zero manual source/config repair on the supported success matrix, zero generated TS/JS or deployment-config changes for same-contract updates, and zero copied framework runtime/checker implementations in fresh apps.
metrics

Record changed consumer files, generated artifacts, manual interventions, command count, duplicate validation executions, implementation LOC and relevant time/RSS baselines; distinguish real removal from relocation and test growth.
notes: Reuse the accepted simplification review P1-P8 and the completed PR49 work. Keep the shell-only default, native Effect APIs, TanStack routing, React/Tailwind/i18n, multi-shell composition, independent delivery units and Node/Cloudflare. A same-contract update may update dependency manifests, the lockfile and narrowly derived release identity data; it must not reconstruct authored source or topology. Genuine public/schema changes use the explicit migration path.
verify: Signed-off fixture/metric contract with exact starting revisions and commands; no invented percentage savings. Separately identify upstream framework refreshes and consumer cohort updates.

title: Prepare and land genuine upstream fixes or extension points
scope: Clean upstream proposal branches and tests, with exact references back to blocked audited identities; no fork lane edits.
todos: prepare

Prepare independently justified upstream-native bug fixes or generic extension points for every route that cannot fit a lawful fork patch, with minimal reproductions and tests on a pinned genuine upstream checkout.
submit
Present concrete reviewed patches and obtain explicit upstream submission authorization at execution time; then submit and track those PRs without publishing fork-specific policy into upstream.
land

Record accepted upstream commits and exact semantics, or redesign rejected proposals through a lawful alternative; leave dependent release work blocked until every required upstream route is actually available.
notes: This planning request does not authorize upstream PR submission. Prepare work can run alongside fork-owned implementation after interfaces are frozen; upstream review time is an external dependency, never a fake completed milestone. Do not divide one conceptual over-cap remediation into artificial PRs, manufacture tiny touches to raise historical budgets, or remove meaningful tests to reduce a count.
verify: Upstream tests and merge provenance for each required seam/fix, exact audited identity mapping and evidence that the incorporated code is genuinely upstream. Proposed patches are not treated as merged source.

title: Implement reviewed upstream provenance carry-forward
scope: scripts/ultramodern-boundary-check provenance validation/writer tests and reviewed design; actual application reserved to packaging/integration.
todos: design

Design a reviewed provenance advancement transaction that keeps audited base eded841256, full canonical scope, immutable renamed identities and per-file budgets; bind the old and new genuine upstream commits and every incorporation conflict.
implement

Implement the separately reviewed transition path with independent CI re-derivation and atomic failure, while retaining current rejection of ad hoc ref/scope/allowlist overrides and preserving historical accounting evidence.
prove

Prove that real merged upstream changes are recognized without erasing residual fork edits, resetting budgets, relabeling renamed identities or accepting fork HEAD as upstream; hand the verified transition contract to integration.
notes: The current writer explicitly refuses upstreamRef changes. Neither --record-growth nor --rebase-divergence-allowlist supplies this missing provenance operation. Design it openly; do not silently repoint the pinned ref. Keep the audited mainline commit rather than the patch-equivalent non-ancestor tag. Add reverse/failed-transition cases, identity collisions, partial overlap with fork edits and non-ancestor/forged refs. A reviewed classifier correction is permissible only for a proved ownership error with adversarial tests, never as a way to exclude real debt.
verify: Positive and negative fixture repositories establish unchanged budgets/identities and exact upstream contribution subtraction; malformed or incomplete transitions leave all files unchanged. No live transition before the required upstream commits exist.
